text: I think you'll really enjoy this Simple and Delicious Low Fat Vegetarian Chili recipe. As a vegetarian looking to increase your fiber intake, this dish is a great fit. The black beans and vegetables provide a good amount of fiber, and the serving time of about 35 minutes fits within your time budget. Additionally, the recipe doesn't include any mushroom, so you can feel confident trying it. Overall, it's a nutritious and flavorful option that should meet your dietary needs and preferences.
